metricFilters.name: FailedConsoleLogins
metricFilters.description: Detects failed AWS Console login attempts

alarmConfiguration.alarmDescription: Alert when 3+ failed login attempts in 5 minutes

metricFilters.name: RootAccountUsage
metricFilters.description: Detects root account activity (should be minimal)

alarmConfiguration.alarmDescription: Alert on any root account usage
Alert when 5+ unauthorized API calls in 5 minutes

metricFilters.name: IAMPolicyChanges
metricFilters.filterPattern: { ($.eventName = PutUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = PutGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = AttachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachGroupPolicy) }

metricFilters.name: SecurityGroupChanges
metricFilters.filterPattern: { ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress) || ($.eventName = RevokeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = RevokeSecurityGroupEgress) || ($.eventName = CreateSecurityGroup) || ($.eventName = DeleteSecurityGroup) }

metricFilters.name: NetworkACLChanges
metricFilters.filterPattern: { ($.eventName = CreateNetworkAcl) || ($.eventName = CreateNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = DeleteNetworkAcl) || ($.eventName = DeleteNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = ReplaceNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation) }

metricFilters.name: S3BucketPolicyChanges
metricFilters.filterPattern: { ($.eventSource = s3.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = PutBucketAcl) || ($.eventName = PutBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutBucketCors) || ($.eventName = PutBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = PutBucketReplication) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketCors) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketReplication)) }

alarmConfiguration.alarmDescription: Alert on S3 bucket policy modifications
Alert on console logins without MFA

metricFilters.name: EC2LargeInstanceLaunches
metricFilters.description: Detects large EC2 instance launches (cost control)

alarmConfiguration.alarmDescription: Alert on large EC2 instance launches

notes.filterPatternSyntax: CloudWatch Logs filter patterns use JSON property notation with $ prefix
notes.wildcards: Use * for wildcard matching in string values
notes.existenceChecks: Use 'EXISTS' or 'NOT EXISTS' to check field presence
notes.defaultValue: Leave null to only publish metric when pattern matches (recommended)

bestPractices: Use specific filter patterns to reduce false positives
Set appropriate alarm thresholds based on normal activity baseline
Test filter patterns with CloudWatch Logs Insights before creating metric filters
Use custom namespaces to organize security metrics logically
Document alarm response procedures for security team
Review and tune alarms regularly to reduce alert fatigue
Consider using composite alarms for complex alerting logic
